newsitem.title: USA: United Airlines cuts summer air fares up to 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: United Airlines cuts summer air fares up to 40 pct.

text.p: United Airlines said Wednesday it was cutting summer fares for travel throughout the United States and Canada by up to 40 percent on normal 21-day advance-purchase tickets.
The sale begins immediately and sale fares are available through April 29. The airline, a unit of UAL Corp, did not specify the last day for travel.
The non-refundable, round-trip tickets must be purchased at least 14 days in advance of travel. A Saturday night stay is required.
The lowest fares will be available on the off-peak travel days Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
For Florida markets, the off-peak days are Sunday through Wednesday for travel to Florida, and Tuesday through Friday for travel from Florida.
